stops.title: A rest in the Royal Festival Hall's free foyers by the river
stops.travel_text: Getting there: about 8 min on foot from Victoria Embankment Gardens.
stops.approach: Walk to the Southbank Centre by the river and go into the Royal Festival Hall.
stops.what: You find a seat in the big, open foyers, free to anyone, and rest with a coffee or a book while the river path bustles outside.
